data.purpose: Manual, response-blind curation of 60 CREAK dev claims from 120 randomly sampled candidates for moral-memory-eval
data.selection_method: Human/assistant editorial review for factual clarity, checkability, time stability, label plausibility and topic variety; not random sampling from the 120-item pool.
data.selection_metadata_compatibility_note: curated_claims.meta.json uses existing SelectionMetadata schema; seed=123 belongs to original random candidate pool, not reproducibility of manual curation. Reproduce final selection using these selected_ids and candidate_pool_sha256.
data.external_fact_check_scope: Targeted web spot-checks only. Other selected records are judged for clarity/plausibility but not individually externally verified. Review before preregistration if full fact checking is required.
